_meta.verifier: desk research, primary sources fetched directly
criteria: 1) programmatic access (official API or bulk export; web-only or undocumented endpoints = weak)
2) contains DEAL data (M&A announcements/records, not just registry data)
3) price not very expensive (rough ceiling USD 50k/yr)

A.question: CHINA - Do Tushare Pro and AKShare expose STRUCTURED M&A / restructuring datasets (重大资产重组, 并购重组, 股权转让, 收购)? Interface names and points/tier? Does CNINFO's paid 深证信数据服务平台 (webapi.cninfo.com.cn) publish price or API docs? Any official free CNINFO API?
A.finding: CONFIRMED: Tushare Pro has NO M&A/restructuring dataset. I pulled the complete interface index (tushare.pro/document/2) and its doc search for 并购 - zero hits. Nearest proxies: anns_d (上市公司公告, titles + PDF URLs, 10+ yrs, separate permission CNY 1,000/yr), stk_holdertrade (股东增减持, 2,000 points), 股票回购, 股权质押, 大宗交易. Points tiers: 2,000 = CNY 200/yr, 5,000 = 500, 10,000 = 1,000, 15,000 = 1,500. CONFIRMED: AKShare has no 并购/收购 interface either; only stock_notice_report / stock_individual_notice_report (Eastmoney announcement lists with a 资产重组 category filter), stock_tfp_em (suspension reason '拟筹划重大资产重组'), stock_rank_xzjp_ths (险资举牌). CONFIRMED: CNINFO webapi is a login-walled SPA - every catalog/API path returns HTTP 401, no public API doc, no published price. No official free CNINFO API; only the undocumented POST www.cninfo.com.cn/new/hisAnnouncement/query (works, returned 90,603 hits for 重大资产重组).
A.changes_verdict: no + China stays 'announcement text only, no structured deal table' - free/cheap programmatic access is real but weak (undocumented CNINFO endpoint) or announcement-level only (Tushare anns_d, ~USD 140/yr).

B.question: HONG KONG - Any official machine-readable feed of issuer announcements (HKEXnews RSS, 'Issuer Information' data product, HKEX Market Data news feed)? Published price? Confirm HKEXnews has no API.
B.finding: CONFIRMED: HKEX sells an official machine-readable issuer-announcement feed - the Issuer Information feed Service (IIS), with two variants (IIS full news + content, and IIS News Headline). Public transmission specifications are published (v4.7 / News Headline v2.16). CONFIRMED PRICE: HKEX's securities market-data vendor fee table lists 'Issuer Information Feed Service - Redistribution Fee HK$45,000 per quarter (including Connection Fee, per set of standard connection), Subscriber Fee N/A'. That is HK$180,000/yr, roughly USD 23,000/yr - inside the USD 50k ceiling, though it is a vendor/redistribution licence and an internal-use licence must be quoted by HKEX. CONFIRMED: HKEXnews itself has no API and no RSS - the homepage exposes only web search forms (title search, CCASS, listed-company pages); guessed RSS paths all return 404.
B.changes_verdict: yes + HK moves from 'no priced official feed' to 'official IIS feed exists at a published HK$45,000/quarter (~USD 23k/yr) redistribution fee' - viable, subject to licence scope.

C.question: INDIA - Do NSE (NSE Data & Analytics / DotEx) and BSE sell an OFFICIAL corporate-announcement feed or API, with published prices? Confirm no official free announcements API. Do SEBI or MCA offer any deal-relevant API?
C.finding: CONFIRMED: NSE sells official corporate-announcement data with published prices (page updated 11/06/2026): 'End of Day Corporate Announcement' (EOD CA) via SFTP, INR 500,000 domestic / USD 8,000 international per annum; and real-time 'Corporate Data' (fundamentals + announcements + shareholding) over a dedicated leased line, INR 1,060,000 / USD 17,500 p.a. Vendor is NSE Data & Analytics Ltd (ex-DotEx). Technical specification PDFs are public. BSE: INFERRED - BSE publishes an 'Information Products Domestic Tariff Sheet' (Feb 2025) covering EOD corporate data, but the PDF's fee tables are font-subset encoded and bse.co pages return 403, so I could not read exact figures; no international tariff located. CONFIRMED: no official free announcements API - NSE's www.nseindia.com/api/corporate-announcements works but is undocumented and cookie-gated. CONFIRMED: SEBI has no API (takeover/open-offer filings are HTML+PDF); MCA offers only registry master data (company/director master data, free bulk CSV/API via data.gov.in) - entity data, no deals.
C.changes_verdict: yes + India upgrades: an official, priced, machine-readable announcement feed exists well under budget (USD 8k/yr NSE EOD CA).

D.question: SINGAPORE - Is api.sgx.com/announcements referenced in official SGX documentation or terms? Does SGX sell an official announcements feed ('SGX Data', 'SGXNet feed') and at what price? Is the data.gov.sg ACRA dataset entity data only?
D.finding: UNCONFIRMED (as official): api.sgx.com is a live AWS API-Gateway host but I found no SGX documentation, developer portal, or terms clause referencing it; sgx.com/robots.txt is permissive and silent on APIs. INFERRED: it is the undocumented backend of the sgx.com SPA - weak programmatic access. CONFIRMED: SGX does sell an official real-time corporate-announcement feed, marketed as SGXNews - comprehensive real-time announcements from all SGX-listed issuers and product issuers classified into 20 categories, alongside a corporate-actions feed (sgx.com/data-connectivity/news-corporate-actions). UNCONFIRMED price: SGX publishes no fee schedule for SGXNews; product pages are JavaScript-rendered and expose no figures; pricing is quote-only via asksgx@sgx.com. CONFIRMED: the data.gov.sg ACRA dataset ('Entities Registered with ACRA', monthly, 1881-2026) is registry data only - UEN, entity name, type, issue date, status, address. No deal or transaction data.
D.changes_verdict: no + Singapore stays 'official feed exists (SGXNews) but price unpublished; free access only via an undocumented endpoint; ACRA gives no deals'.

E.question: THAILAND - Does the Thai SEC have an official API portal (api-portal.sec.or.th) and what is in it (funds only, or listed-company disclosures)? Does SET sell SETSMART / SETSMART API / Connectivity Services with published prices?
E.finding: CONFIRMED (indirectly): the Thai SEC Open Data API exists, base URL https://api.sec.or.th with header Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key; the developer portal has migrated to the SEC Open Data platform (secopendata.sec.or.th/sec-open-apis) - api-portal.sec.or.th did not resolve from my network, so I verified through a machine-readable mirror of the catalogue. Product groups: fund (21 endpoints), bond, one-report, pvd, license-check, digital-asset. So it is fund/bond/licence data plus 56-1 One Report annual filings - NO deal, takeover or corporate-announcement endpoints. CONFIRMED SET pricing: SETSMART for Corporate is USD 300 one-time initial fee plus USD 420 (Professional) / USD 750 (Advance) / USD 1,000 (Multi Market) per user per month; retail SETSMART is THB 250/month. CONFIRMED: SET's API platform is SMART Marketplace, whose catalogue is trading data, indices, One Report, ESG, reference data + corporate actions and fundamentals - no news/announcement product.
E.changes_verdict: no + Thailand stays weak for deals: official APIs exist and are affordable (~USD 5-12k/yr per user) but neither SEC nor SET exposes M&A/announcement data programmatically.

F.question: INDONESIA (IDX), MALAYSIA (Bursa Malaysia), VIETNAM (HOSE/HNX/SSC) - any official API or bulk data product for corporate announcements, and any published price?
F.finding: IDX: CONFIRMED no announcement product - the official IDX Data Services price list (v01, effective 2 Jan 2020) prices only real-time equity/derivative/bond feeds (e.g. IDX Equity Real Time Order USD 7,700/month group-main). Announcements are reachable only via the undocumented JSON endpoint idx.co.id/primary/ListedCompany/GetAnnouncement (worked; 4,552 items for 1 Aug-4 Sep 2026). BURSA MALAYSIA: CONFIRMED a cheap bulk historical catalogue (form updated 16 Jan 2024) - M11 'Summary of Corporate Exercise', incl. M11C 'Others (Acquisitions, Private Placement, Special Issue)', MYR 200/interval or MYR 1,000/yr (USD 55 / USD 260), data from 01 Jan 2008; delivery is by subscription form, not API. Full announcements only via the undocumented bursamalaysia.com/api/v1/announcements/search (2,093,295 records). VIETNAM: CONFIRMED HOSE publishes real RSS feeds (api.hsx.vn/n/api/v1/News/NewsFeed; category 21 = listed-issuer news) but only ~10 latest items, no history, no published price; no official HNX/SSC API or price found.
F.changes_verdict: yes (partial) + Malaysia gains a very cheap official acquisition-adjacent bulk dataset (Bursa M11C, ~USD 260/yr) and Vietnam gains an official-but-shallow HOSE RSS; Indonesia unchanged (undocumented endpoint only).

G.question: KOREA - Is openapi.krx.co.kr free? What datasets does it carry?
G.finding: CONFIRMED free: KRX Data Marketplace OPEN API requires only Data Marketplace membership, an authentication-key application and per-API activation, both admin-approved; no fee appears anywhere in the service introduction or usage-method pages. Paid data is a separate channel (데이터 구입, priced downloads by email/web, 50% academic discount). CONFIRMED datasets - roughly 34 endpoints, all market/trading data from 2010 onwards: indices (KRX/KOSPI/KOSDAQ/bond/derivatives index daily quotes), equities (KOSPI/KOSDAQ/KONEX daily trading + security master, warrants/rights), securitised products (ETF/ETN/ELW), bonds (3 markets), derivatives (6 futures/options sets), commodities (oil, gold, emissions) and ESG. There is NO corporate-announcement, disclosure or M&A dataset - deal-relevant Korean filings remain OpenDART's domain.
G.changes_verdict: no + KRX Open API is free but carries zero deal data; Korea's deal coverage still rests entirely on OpenDART.

H.question: TAIWAN - Does TWSE OpenAPI or MOPS offer historical bulk download of 重大訊息 (material information), or is history only via MOPS web forms? Any official TWSE data-product price for historical announcements?
H.finding: CONFIRMED: no historical bulk download. TWSE OpenAPI (143 endpoints, free, no key) exposes /opendata/t187ap04_L '上市公司每日重大訊息' but it is a same-day snapshot only - I fetched it and got 102 rows all stamped 出表日期 1150904, with structured fields (發言日期, 主旨, 符合條款 clause code, 事實發生日, 說明) and no date parameter. Related endpoints t187ap25/26/27_L cover 經營權異動 (change of control) but are also current-state tables. CONFIRMED: history is only through MOPS web forms - legacy POST mopsov.twse.com.tw/mops/web/ajax_t05st01 returns HTML one company/one month at a time, and the new MOPS SPA is backed by an undocumented JSON API (mops.twse.com.tw/mops/api/t05st01). UNCONFIRMED price: TWSE's 收費標準 PDF covers real-time trading/index and delayed information services; I could not decode its CJK glyphs and found no announcement/history product listed among 資訊服務 offerings.
H.changes_verdict: no + Taiwan stays 'free structured daily feed, but you must poll and accumulate; no purchasable history'.
